signature.name: VTask.copy
signature.type: {E : Type u_2} -> {F : Type u_3} -> [NormedAddCommGroup E] -> [NormedSpace ℝ E] -> [NormedAddCommGroup F] -> [NormedSpace ℝ F] -> {n : ℕ∞} -> {K : TopologicalSpace.Compacts E} -> (f : ContDiffMapSupportedIn E F n K) -> (f' : E → F) -> (h : f' = ⇑f) -> ContDiffMapSupportedIn E F n K

conventions.statement: The result of VTask.copy f f' h is propositionally equal to the original f as an element of ContDiffMapSupportedIn E F n K.
conventions.note: This holds because h witnesses f' = ⇑f, so all fields coincide.

conventions.statement: The coercion of VTask.copy f f' h to a bare function E → F is definitionally (and propositionally) equal to f', the supplied replacement function.
conventions.note: This is the main purpose of copy: to install f' as the toFun field.

facts.statement: ∀ {E : Type*} {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] {n : ℕ∞} {K : TopologicalSpace.Compacts E} (f : ContDiffMapSupportedIn E F n K) (f' : E → F) (h : f' = ⇑f), VTask.copy f f' h = f

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ {E : Type*} {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] {n : ℕ∞} {K : TopologicalSpace.Compacts E} (f : ContDiffMapSupportedIn E F n K) (f' : E → F) (h : f' = ⇑f), ⇑(VTask.copy f f' h) = ⇑f

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ {E : Type*} {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] {n : ℕ∞} {K : TopologicalSpace.Compacts E} (f : ContDiffMapSupportedIn E F n K) (f' : E → F) (h : f' = ⇑f) (f'' : E → F) (h' : f'' = ⇑(VTask.copy f f' h)), VTask.copy (VTask.copy f f' h) f'' h' = f

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ {E : Type*} {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] {n : ℕ∞} {K : TopologicalSpace.Compacts E} (f g : ContDiffMapSupportedIn E F n K) (h_ne : f ≠ g) (h : ⇑g = ⇑f), VTask.copy f (⇑g) h = f

facts.statement: ∀ {E : Type*} {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] {n : ℕ∞} {K : TopologicalSpace.Compacts E} (f : ContDiffMapSupportedIn E F n K) (f' : E → F) (h : f' = ⇑f) (x : E), (VTask.copy f f' h : E → F) x = f x

facts.statement: ∀ {E : Type*} {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] {n : ℕ∞} {K : TopologicalSpace.Compacts E} (f g : ContDiffMapSupportedIn E F n K) (f' : E → F) (h : f' = ⇑f), f ≠ g → VTask.copy f f' h ≠ g
